sloka: सा क्षिप्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तस्मिन् शूले पपात ह ।भिन्नः शक्त्या महान् शूलो निपपात हतद्युतिः ।। ६.१०४.२८ ।।
transliteration: sā kṣiptā rākṣasendrasya tasmin śūle papāta ha ।bhinnaḥ śaktyā mahān śūlo nipapāta hatadyutiḥ ।। 6.104.28 ।।

translations.english: With the hurling of the javelin by Rama at the great trident of Ravana and on (the javelin) touching the trident, it was broken, lost its splendour and fell down.
